cues: Bio pesticides are living things, or substances from them, used against pests.
The fungus Trichoderma against soil borne diseases.
And tiny Trichogramma wasps that parasitise the eggs of borers.
They are specific, spare bees and birds, and leave no residue, though they act slowly and do not keep long.
text: Bio pesticides are living things, or substances from them, used against pests. Bt against caterpillars. The fungus Trichoderma against soil borne diseases. A virus against Helicoverpa. Neem. And tiny Trichogramma wasps that parasitise the eggs of borers. They are specific, spare bees and birds, and leave no residue, though they act slowly and do not keep long.
